claim: The 69 independently verified joint-support rejections and 34 disjoint seed-local pentad-cover rejections eliminate exactly 103 of the frozen 258 K7 residue graphs. Exactly 155 remain.

semantics.seed_quantifier: A new graph is rejected only when one required K7 seed has a nonempty exact inherited-passing cover set and every such cover either has no propagation/sparse-value support family or has an exact coefficientwise-positive rank-two pentad certificate.
